unarr RAR decoder for OpenCloud Comic Reader
============================================

What is in this folder

  unarr-rar.wasm      unarr's RAR reader compiled to WebAssembly.
  unarr-rar.mjs       The loader Emscripten generates for it.
  unarr-extract.mjs   OpenCloud Comic Reader's extraction loop
                      (AGPL-3.0-or-later).
  unarr-worker.mjs    OpenCloud Comic Reader's worker around it
                      (AGPL-3.0-or-later).
  COPYING.LESSER      GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3.
  COPYING             GNU General Public License, version 3, which the
                      Lesser GPL incorporates by reference.

unarr

  unarr, https://github.com/selmf/unarr
  commit df462f20a449ced3dd840ae7197d86d28ac5cfe3 (2026-11-01): version 1.2.0
  plus the development commits made after that release, up to this one.
  Copyright the unarr project authors. Licensed under the LGPL version 3.
  It includes code from The Unarchiver project, and from the LZMA SDK and
  GNUnet (crc32), both of which are in the public domain.

  Only the RAR reader is compiled in: common/, rar/ and the PPMd parts of
  lzmasdk/, with a small interface of OpenCloud Comic Reader's own (glue.c).
  unarr's sources are unmodified; native/unarr/upstream.sha256 in the source
  package lists the hash of every file, for comparison with a checkout of that
  commit.

Source and rebuilding

  The complete corresponding source is part of OpenCloud Comic Reader's source
  package, under native/unarr/: the unarr sources used (upstream/), the
  small C interface compiled with them (glue.c) and the build script
  (build.sh). `sh scripts/build-unarr.sh` builds both files from them with
  the Emscripten SDK 7.0.0 container, pinned by digest. The build is
  reproducible, so the copies in this folder should be:

    4639acf4ab9dd5bbdc5027a3de0cad08f82ed047ee89c33785e09e00c598a273  unarr-rar.mjs
    7efd6845dfbde91ca5aadd65a31772c00ccdcf9f79d496f3953f970ffdad51a6  unarr-rar.wasm

  To use a modified unarr, rebuild and replace those two files. Nothing else
  in the app needs to change.
